newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-GUALDI CLAIMS ITALY'S 11TH STAGE WIN.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-GUALDI CLAIMS ITALY'S 11TH STAGE WIN.

text.p: Former world champion Mirko Gualdi gave Italy their 11th stage victory in the Giro d'Italia on Tuesday.
He outsprinted Alessandro Pozzi and Colombian Jose Gonzalez for the second biggest win of his career since he took the 1990 amateur world road race title in Japan.
The trio had escaped from a group of eight after Gonzalez had attacked in the final 30 kilometres of the 200 from Dalmine.
Giro leader Ivan Gotti and chief rivals, Russian Pavel Tonkov and Frenchman Luc Leblance, finished with the main pack, five minutes 46 seconds behind Gualdi. Gotti still leads Tonkov by 51 seconds.
